mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 4% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with a strong increase in payroll employment, signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a decrease in supply and potential shortages, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when industrial production is below 100 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate, combined with a strong increase in CPI, signals a potential monetary tightening cycle and decreased borrowing, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during monetary tightening cycles (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a tight labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).
